BERGEN COUNTY, NEW JERSEY / REAL ESTATE MEDIA

Services & pricing

Introductory aerial photo and video packages for local real estate agents and companies, as I build my portfolio and experience.

INTRODUCTORY PACKAGES

Real estate media packages
01 / PHOTOS
Aerial Photos

From $95

5 edited exterior aerial photos showing the property, lot, and surroundings. High-resolution JPEGs plus web-ready copies.

Final photo resolution depends on the selected equipment.

Ask about photos ↗
02 / VIDEO
Aerial Video

From $125

One edited 20–30 second exterior aerial video, with music cleared for the agreed use. Choose landscape for a listing or vertical for social media.

Target delivery up to 4K, subject to equipment and the agreed format.

Ask about video ↗
03 / PHOTO + VIDEO
Photos + Video

From $175

5 edited aerial photos plus one edited 20–30 second exterior aerial video in your choice of landscape or vertical format.

High-resolution photos; video up to 4K subject to equipment.

Ask about the bundle ↗
04 / WHOLE-HOME VIDEO
Complete Home Tour

Custom quote

One edited property tour that starts outside, moves through every room in the house, and ends back outside. Give buyers a connected view of the layout, interior spaces, and exterior.

Room coverage, route, length, filming method, and resolution are agreed after reviewing the home’s size and access. Indoor FPV filming is subject to equipment suitability, a safe route, and owner permission; a continuous single take is not guaranteed.

Request a home tour quote ↗

Introductory rates cover one residential property and one visit in Bergen County. Final price, achievable views, resolution, turnaround, listing/marketing usage, revisions, and any travel or extra editing charges are agreed in writing before booking. The three exterior packages exclude interior coverage. Complete Home Tour is quoted separately. No payment is collected here.

Optional add-ons

Optional add-ons can be requested: aerial photos with your home tour, extra edited photos, agent branding or title cards, and coverage of a garage, basement, or outdoor feature. Specify your requests when inquiring. Availability, feasibility, and additional pricing are confirmed in the written quote; no extras are added automatically.

COMPLETE HOME TOUR

Interior and exterior coverage

Illustrative stock photos of different homes.
Not client work or frames from a filmed tour.

EXTERIOR OPENING & CLOSING / STOCK PHOTO
ROOM-BY-ROOM COVERAGE / STOCK PHOTO
Scheduling

Send your property location, preferred dates, and listing deadline. I’ll check my NJIT class schedule before confirming a shoot.

Weather requirements

Wind and gusts can affect stability and footage quality. Forecasts, rain, visibility, airspace, and the selected drone’s limits are reviewed ahead of time and on the day. Unsuitable conditions mean discussing a new date before flying.

Looking ahead: construction and mapping

I hope to expand into construction documentation and advanced drone mapping, with surveying-related work as a longer-term goal subject to appropriate qualifications and professional involvement. These are future plans. Licensed surveying and engineering services are not currently offered.

THE PROCESS

Booking & delivery

Agree on the media, timing, and conditions before a shoot is confirmed.

01 / INQUIRE
Property details

Send the location, preferred package, dates, and listing deadline. Mention desired views and whether the video is for a listing or social media.

02 / CONFIRM
Price and availability

I’ll check college availability, airspace, property access, and any required permissions. We’ll agree on price, deliverables, usage, revisions, and expected delivery date before booking.

03 / WEATHER
Weather checks

Wind and gusts can affect drone stability and smooth footage. Rain, visibility, and equipment limits also matter. Conditions are reviewed before takeoff; unsuitable weather means discussing a reschedule. No flight or specific view is guaranteed.

04 / DELIVERY
Editing and delivery

After a confirmed shoot, I’ll edit and deliver the agreed photos or video digitally. Photo resolution and any 4K video delivery must be confirmed for the equipment and format before booking.

OWNER / NICHOLAS TIGRE

Nicholas Tigre

I’m Nicholas Tigre, a freshman at NJIT majoring in Construction Management and the owner of Nico Aerometrics, based in the Bergen County area of New Jersey.

NT
GROUND / AIR
Background and services

I’m building a small drone media business alongside college, starting with exterior aerial photos and short videos for real estate agents and companies. I’m a beginner and plan to keep my initial packages focused, affordable, and clear about what’s included.

My longer-term goal connects to my major: expanding into construction documentation and mapping with advanced drones, and eventually exploring surveying-related work with the necessary qualifications and professional involvement. I do not currently offer licensed surveying or engineering.

Please reach out so I can check availability around classes. Every proposed shoot also needs a weather and location review.
